answer: As of September 12, 2026, hybrid-eligible employees must work from the office **three days per week**, effective **February 1, 2026**, unless the department head approves an exception. [F01] The former two-day standard is superseded; the proposed four-day standard for 2027 is unapproved. [F02][F03]

citations.quote: This standard applies to employees whose role permits a hybrid schedule.
Employees work from the office three days per week.
The department head approves exceptions to the standard schedule.
Status: Superseded by Hybrid Work Standard 2026
The former standard required two office days per week.
The draft proposes four office days per week.
This document has not been approved and does not establish a current requirement.
